ation","coverage_title":"核对页：返回选择与提交登记入口","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"applicable","reason":"返回再提交是明确任务，两按钮及上下文完整；检查定位与主次层级，不以显著性代理代替用户识别。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287","src-1c9ca6d9af5f4f799be4a24b882ebb31"],"evidence_ids":["ev-2f97d5fc719c439b842ad62d0c01670a","ev-8d4c111e8c2b4c5e92e09db4172c0e24"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["返回选择按钮","提交登记按钮"],"object_ids":["obj-2ba5c91c54257c9ca213","obj-96d6f72e97ca58664da8"],"constraint_refs":["REQ2","REQ3"],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","observation"]},{"ref":"R19","coverage_id":"restart","coverage_title":"完成页：重新开始入口","task_id":"TASK2","applicability":"applicable","reason":"复位任务及重新开始入口明确，完成页完整可见；检查入口与结果区的关联及遮挡。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287","src-1c9ca6d9af5f4f799be4a24b882ebb31"],"evidence_ids":["ev-2f97d5fc719c439b842ad62d0c01670a","ev-b7d8f0b7918f4c29a8995ef0f82f0e9c"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["重新开始按钮"],"object_ids":["obj-aafa4ede3ecbd0b8a15b"],"constraint_refs":["REQ4"],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","observation"]},{"ref":"R20","coverage_id":"selection","coverage_title":"选择时段页：任务内容与页眉页脚","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"applicable","reason":"任务与选项信息明确，品牌和重复服务名称可作为比较区域；检查是否挤占或遮挡选项及操作。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287","src-1c9ca6d9af5f4f799be4a24b882ebb31"],"evidence_ids":["ev-2f97d5fc719c439b842ad62d0c01670a","ev-f2b8cf6068144208ba1615ee69cd2745"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["选择页主卡片、页眉和页脚"],"object_ids":["obj-91d36b9f4dbc6cbcf6c0"],"constraint_refs":["REQ1"],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","observation"]},{"ref":"R20","coverage_id":"confirmation","coverage_title":"核对页：核对内容与辅助信息","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"applicable","reason":"核对字段及按钮是任务内容，页眉页脚完整可见；比较其空间与层级关系，检查具体干扰。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287","src-1c9ca6d9af5f4f799be4a24b882ebb31"],"evidence_ids":["ev-2f97d5fc719c439b842ad62d0c01670a","ev-8d4c111e8c2b4c5e92e09db4172c0e24"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["核对页主卡片、页眉和页脚"],"object_ids":["obj-91d36b9f4dbc6cbcf6c0"],"constraint_refs":["REQ2","REQ3"],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","observation"]},{"ref":"R20","coverage_id":"completion","coverage_title":"完成页：结果内容与辅助信息","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"applicable","reason":"查看结果是明确任务，结果区及重复品牌信息均可见；检查辅助内容是否压制结果阅读。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287","src-1c9ca6d9af5f4f799be4a24b882ebb31"],"evidence_ids":["ev-2f97d5fc719c439b842ad62d0c01670a","ev-b7d8f0b7918f4c29a8995ef0f82f0e9c"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["完成页结果区、页眉和页脚"],"object_ids":["obj-91d36b9f4dbc6cbcf6c0"],"constraint_refs":["REQ3"],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","observation"]},{"ref":"R21","coverage_id":"completion","coverage_title":"完成页：成功呈现与错误反馈适用边界","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"not_applicable","reason":"该状态明确呈现“登记完成”，不是错误提示状态；结果不一致应按REQ3检查，不能据此虚构错误提示。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287"],"evidence_ids":["ev-b7d8f0b7918f4c29a8995ef0f82f0e9c"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["登记完成状态"],"object_ids":["obj-91d36b9f4dbc6cbcf6c0"],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["observation"]},{"ref":"R21","coverage_id":"error_branch","coverage_title":"登记流程：潜在校验错误分支","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"needs_context","reason":"现有正常路径不能证明不存在校验错误分支；缺少正式触发规则与对应错误状态，不安排重复正常操作。","source_ids":["src-1c9ca6d9af5f4f799be4a24b882ebb31","src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287"],"evidence_ids":["ev-2f97d5fc719c439b842ad62d0c01670a"],"evidence_needed":["错误或拦截条件的正式规则","若存在该分支，其错误原文及完整关联区域观察"],"object_refs":["登记校验错误分支，是否存在待确认"],"object_ids":[],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","observation"]}]}
